ddl.where: company_id IS NULL AND is_system_default = true
ddl.name: role_system_default_unique

ddl.where: cancelled_at IS NULL AND role_id IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: form_active_role_assignment

ddl.where: cancelled_at IS NULL AND company_member_id IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: form_active_member_assignment

ddl.where: answer_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_entry_id IS NULL
ddl.name: form_one_answer_review_root

ddl.value: num_nonnulls(location_id, checked_in_latitude, checked_in_longitude, location_name_snapshot, location_latitude_snapshot, location_longitude_snapshot, radius_meters_snapshot) IN (0, 7)
ddl.name: attendance_location_snapshot_complete_check

ddl.value: location_id IS NULL OR (checked_in_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('present', 'late'))
ddl.name: attendance_location_event_check

ddl.value: ((unit IN ('day', 'half_day') AND start_time IS NULL AND end_time IS NULL AND minutes_per_day_snapshot IS NULL) OR (unit = 'hour' AND start_date = end_date AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time > start_time AND minutes_per_day_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND minutes_per_day_snapshot > 0))
ddl.name: leave_request_source_interval_check

ddl.value: replaces_assignment_id IS NULL OR replaces_assignment_id <> id
ddl.name: form_assignment_no_self_check

ddl.value: (cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL) OR (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) > 0)
ddl.name: form_assignment_cancel_check

ddl.value: (cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancelled_by IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL) OR (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_by IS NOT NULL AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(cancel_reason)) > 0)
ddl.name: form_occurrence_cancel_check

ddl.value: effective_until IS NULL OR (effective_from IS NOT NULL AND effective_until > effective_from)
ddl.name: form_plan_effective_check

ddl.value: supersedes_plan_id IS NULL OR supersedes_plan_id <> id
ddl.name: form_plan_no_self_check

ddl.value: closed_by IS NULL OR effective_until IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: form_plan_closed_actor_check

ddl.value: end_local_date IS NULL OR end_local_date >= anchor_local_date
ddl.name: form_schedule_range_check

ddl.value: (role_id IS NOT NULL AND company_member_id IS NULL AND role_distribution IS NOT NULL) OR (role_id IS NULL AND company_member_id IS NOT NULL AND role_distribution IS NULL)
ddl.name: form_plan_target_xor_check

ddl.value: action NOT IN ('NEEDS_CHANGES', 'RETURN') OR (note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(note)) > 0)
ddl.name: form_review_note_check

ddl.value: supersedes_entry_id IS NULL OR supersedes_entry_id <> id
ddl.name: form_review_no_self_check

ddl.value: submitted_at IS NULL OR submitted_at >= created_at
ddl.name: form_submission_time_order_check

ddl.value: supersedes_submission_id IS NULL OR supersedes_submission_id <> id
ddl.name: form_submission_no_self_revision_check

ddl.value: action <> 'RETURN' OR (note IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(note)) > 0)
ddl.name: form_decision_note_check

ddl.value: (status = 'DRAFT' AND published_at IS NULL AND published_by IS NULL) OR (status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ARCHIVED') AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_by IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: form_version_publish_metadata_check
